title: Recording: Occapella by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

The first recording session for Ringo Starr’s fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, was held on 30 May 1974.

‘Occapella’ was written by Allen Toussaint, and originally recorded by Lee Dorsey for his 1970 album Yes We Can.

The recording was completed with additional overdubs on 26 September.

Page last updated: 29 May 2026
